lines.en: I crawl over the rubble on six legs.
My shell scrapes along the sand.

lines.zh: 我沿着木乃伊的脚印走。
lines.en: I follow the mummy's footprints.
My legs slip on the dry grass.
A thin trail of sand follows me.
I circle the stone once.
I walk slowly but never lose my way.
My wing cases knock together behind me.
I squeeze into a crack and out again.
I take the dunes one at a time.
I crawl along beneath the shade.

lines.zh: 这条墓道我走了无数遍。
lines.en: I have walked this tomb passage countless times.
I step over my companion's shell.

lines.zh: 干燥的沙让我走得轻快。
lines.en: Dry sand makes my steps light.

lines.zh: 我跟着队伍爬上墓道台阶。
lines.en: I climb the tomb steps with the swarm.

lines.zh: 沙面上我的影子晃了一下。
lines.en: My shadow jitters across the sand.
I wait for my master to move.
I lift my antennae into the wind.

lines.zh: 我的壳上有细细的划痕。
lines.en: Fine scratches cross my shell.

lines.zh: 我数着墓道里的滴水声。
lines.en: I count the dripping in the passage.
I grind the sand off my mouthparts.
A companion rests on my back.
This dead beetle still has a scent.

lines.zh: 我静静等在木乃伊脚边。
lines.en: I wait quietly at the mummy's heel.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的壳晒得发烫。
lines.en: The sun bakes my shell hot.

lines.zh: 我在沙里埋了半个身子。
lines.en: I have buried half of myself in sand.
When the wind comes, I tuck my legs.
I can tell who is walking.
Tomb dust clings to your soles.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，像看一座山。
lines.en: I look up at you like a mountain.
You smell of living insects.
Will you step on me?
My master is watching you.
Your shadow shades me from the sun.
I know that kind of footstep.
You are too close to my shell.
Keep your hand off my wings.
I must look tiny to you.

lines.zh: 我的壳被压出一道白痕。
lines.en: A white line is pressed into my shell.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的触角断了一节。
lines.en: That blow snapped one of my antennae.

lines.zh: 甲壳里还爬着木乃伊的沙。
lines.en: Mummy sand still crawls in my shell.
My fluids seep into the sand.
The pain keeps my wing cases open.
You cracked my armor.
I curl up and play dead.
I hear my own shell cracking.
I will carry this pain to my master.
That kick will be remembered long.
The smell of carrion stops me.
That dung ball would roll a long way.
Just a drop of sweet sap, please.
I smell overripe fruit.
There is dried meat in your pocket.
I crawl toward what you hold.
That bone still has meat on it.
Sugar water spilled in sand is a waste.
I only want a scrap of rotten hide.
Feed me and I will follow you.
Your kick flipped me onto my back.
My shell hit your boot.
You almost crushed me.
I righted myself; do not help.

lines.zh: 你踩过来时我赶紧缩腿。
lines.en: I tuck my legs in as your foot comes down.
I was knocked halfway into the sand.

lines.zh: 你的脚比我整个身子大。
lines.en: Your foot is bigger than my whole body.
My mouthparts jam into the grit.
Anything that bumps me deserves a bite.

lines.zh: 我的翅鞘被撞开了一条缝。
lines.en: The bump opened a seam in my wing case.

lines.zh: 我滚着一颗粪球去找她。
lines.en: I roll a dung ball to find her.
Her shell shines a little brighter.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这具尸体。
lines.en: We guard this corpse together.

lines.zh: 我用触角碰了碰她的头。
lines.en: I touch her head with my antennae.
There is a burrow for the two of us.

lines.zh: 她愿意和我一起搬食物。
lines.en: She will haul food alongside me.
I spread my wings for her.

lines.zh: 我们在木乃伊脚边成对。
lines.en: We pair up at the mummy's feet.
The swarm will remember this night.
Do not disturb us; we are building.
I lift a scrap of flesh the size of a grain.
This bone chip is mine.
I push the food back home.
The gold nugget is too heavy to drag.
I fold the paper into a mat.

lines.zh: 掉下的面包屑我收下了。
lines.en: I accept the fallen breadcrumbs.
I bite the corner of the cloth.
This feeds the whole nest for a day.
I clamp it with my hind legs.
Whoever dropped it, it is mine now.
My master points that way.
Footsteps are shaking the sand.

lines.zh: 木乃伊的命令把我叫醒。
lines.en: The mummy's command woke me.
The swarm begins to gather in one place.
A shadow falls over my burrow.
I lift my wings, ready to fly.
That sound is not a sandstorm.

lines.zh: 我听见布条摩擦的声音。
lines.en: I hear bandages rubbing together.
Someone has entered our tomb.
My mouthparts begin to work.
Something warm is up ahead.
I crawl toward the scent.
I slip around to your heel.
I wait for my master to strike first.
When you lift your foot, I climb.

lines.zh: 我的同伴已经围住了你。
lines.en: My companions have already surrounded you.
I watch the gap at your trouser cuff.
You cannot step on me; I am quick.

lines.zh: 木乃伊主人的气味在前。
lines.en: My mummy's scent lies ahead.
Dozens of us wait under the sand.
Back to the wall, you run out of room.
I only wait for bare skin.
My master takes the left; I take the right.
My wings are spread as wide as they go.
I sink my jaws into your ankle.
My mouthparts are small but sharp.
This bite will itch more than hurt.
I crawl up your trouser leg and bite.
My companions bite right after me.
Swatting will not reach me.

lines.zh: 我从你的护甲缝里下口。
lines.en: I bite through the gap in your armor.
One bite is enough; I withdraw.

lines.zh: 我的齿上带着墓里的菌。
lines.en: My teeth carry tomb rot.

lines.zh: 你感到刺痛时我已经走了。
lines.en: By the time you feel it, I am gone.

lines.zh: 我从木乃伊的裹布里钻出。
lines.en: I crawl out of the mummy's wrappings.
A summoning tremor runs under the sand.
My shell is hard, my eyes still wet.
My master called me as he fell.

lines.zh: 我从尸体旁的沙里爬上来。
lines.en: I climb from the sand beside the corpse.
The swarm spreads through the passage.
My first breath is dust.
Thirty companions break through the soil.
I was summoned to collect the dead.

lines.zh: 我的翅还在等第一阵风。
lines.en: My wings await their first wind.
Fire makes my shell brittle at a touch.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，我腿先着地。
lines.en: I land legs first from the height.

lines.zh: 水灌进翅鞘，我飞不起来。
lines.en: Water fills my wing cases and I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我掀出很远。
lines.en: The blast throws me far across the sand.
An arrowhead punched through my back plate.

lines.zh: 魔法在我壳上烧出焦斑。
lines.en: Magic burned a scorch mark on my shell.
I am so hungry I chew sand.

lines.zh: 雷把我震得半天不会动。
lines.en: The thunderbolt left me numb and still.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙，也没有主人。
lines.en: The void has no sand and no master.
